instruction.text: Ikrams Familie wird bald umziehen. Ikram erzählt von ihrem neuen Haus. Lies dir den Text durch und entscheide, ob die Aussagen wahr oder falsch sind.

atoms.text: When I was first told the news, I didn't want to move. However, my parents told me more about our new house. I won't have my own bathroom. Just like now, I have to share the bathroom with my older sister, which is a little annoying. I will have my own room though, which is great! Soon, I will have more privacy. Also, we will have a huge garden. We won't have a swimming pool, but we can barbecue and play volleyball in our garden in the summer. Now, I can't wait to move!
